revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, observing an indoor parking garage. Left-oblique view at closer inspection distance, natural perspective, realistic scale, enough surrounding context to judge body support. Scene includes concrete pillars, parked vehicles, lane markings made with industrial vinyl, slightly dim but readable ambient light. Main subject: an older adult woman with a small build, wearing a beige coat, comfortable shoes, and blue and charcoal clothing, lying prone on the ground with back visible, entire body extended in a clear horizontal position. Make it look like a plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, subject clearly visible, clean floor markings that do not form symbols or labels. Ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, non-cinematic, non-advertising look. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, or annotation.
